verdict.rationale: Solid's README states it is 'naturally debuggable' because a `<div>` is a real div you can inspect in browser devtools. It also says Solid compiles templates to real DOM nodes rather than a virtual DOM and gives direct DOM access. A hands-on porter independently notes that refs are just the elements. The community complaint that Solid's own dev tools are alpha concerns a framework extension, not inspecting real DOM in browser devtools, so it does not contradict this story. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the browser-devtools debugging workflow, and independent hands-on reports of debugging rendered output in browser devtools.
